projects.title: RateLimiter
projects.desc: A dependency-free Python rate limiter with four interchangeable algorithms (fixed window, sliding window log, sliding window counter, token bucket), thread-safe storage, and a small HTTP decision service that speaks the IETF RateLimit headers.
bullets: Implemented four rate-limiting algorithms behind one interface and benchmarked their throughput, per-key memory and accuracy under different traffic patterns.

Raised HTTP throughput from ~22 to about 4,700 requests/sec on one keep-alive connection by tracing the stall to Nagle's algorithm plus delayed ACKs, then buffering each response into one write and setting TCP_NODELAY.
Fixed memory that never shrank after sweeping idle keys (CPython dicts don't shrink on delete) by rebuilding the mapping on sweep.
Covered the algorithms, concurrency (8 threads on one key), bounded memory and the real HTTP server with 82 tests that run in under a second using a fake clock.

projects.title: envlens
projects.desc: A zero-dependency Python CLI that compares the environment variables your code reads against your .env and .env.example files, across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Ruby and Go, and reports every mismatch with file:line locations without ever printing a value.
bullets: Built a three-way drift check (code vs .env vs .env.example) that finds missing, undocumented, unfilled, unused and duplicate variables in one pass.
Parsed Python with the ast module so lookups in comments and strings are ignored, with regex scanners for JavaScript/TypeScript, Ruby and Go.
Designed for secret safety: values are never stored in findings or printed, and broken multiline secrets are reported without echoing their fragments.
CI-friendly exit codes and JSON output, backed by 177 unit tests.

projects.title: BrainBoard
projects.desc: AI-powered collaborative whiteboard that transforms rough ideas into structured concept maps in real time. An embedded GPT-4 agent automatically clusters, expands, and connects user input — supporting 10+ simultaneous collaborators with sub-2s AI response times.
bullets: Accelerated team ideation sessions by 3× by building a real-time collaborative whiteboard with React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
Achieved 90% contextual relevance by engineering a prompt system with persona-based prompts, summarization chains, and temperature-tuned expansion tailored to each brainstorming domain.
Supported 10+ simultaneous users with sub-2s AI suggestions by architecting a WebSocket sync engine with Redis pub/sub and batched AI request queuing to avoid rate limits.

projects.title: Voyage
projects.desc: Full-stack travel planning application that lets users build custom itineraries or generate AI-powered trip plans via the Gemini API. Features persistent user accounts, cross-device responsiveness, and a custom caching layer that cut AI token costs by 20%.
bullets: Enabled users to plan trips through custom itineraries or AI-generated travel plans by building a full-stack application with JavaScript, Flask, HTML, CSS, and Docker, integrated with the Gemini API.
Delivered a responsive cross-device experience with quick retrieval of past plans by building user account management with persistent itinerary storage.
Reduced API latency and cut Gemini AI token costs by 20% by containerizing the application with Docker and implementing a custom caching layer for Gemini AI and Google Maps API responses.

projects.title: LinkPulse
projects.desc: High-performance URL shortener with a live analytics dashboard. Achieved sub-10ms redirect times and reduced PostgreSQL read load by 60% through Redis caching. Streams real-time click data — including geo distribution, referrer tracking, and time-series charts — to a React dashboard via WebSockets.
bullets: Achieved sub-10ms redirect response times and reduced PostgreSQL read load by 60% by implementing a Redis caching layer for high-frequency short link lookups under simulated concurrent traffic.

Delivered real-time click analytics including geographic distribution, referrer tracking, and time-series visualizations by building a WebSocket-driven event pipeline that streams click data to a React dashboard.
Prevented API abuse while sustaining 500+ requests per minute per user by designing Express.js rate-limiting middleware with Redis-backed sliding window counters.

experience.desc: Building AI agents that automate and optimize supply chain decisions, working across the agent pipeline, backend services, and evaluation tooling.
bullets: Reduced LLM token usage per agent run by ~3% (~400 tokens per run) by trimming redundant prompt context and caching repeated supplier lookups, cutting duplicate lookup calls by ~15%.
Improved agent tool-call success rate by ~2% (from ~94% to ~96%) by adding schema validation and automatic retries for malformed tool calls, reducing manual workflow reruns by ~10%.
Cut p95 latency of multi-step agent workflows by ~5% (~0.4s) by running independent tool calls in parallel and batching database reads, reducing database round trips per run by ~20%.
Raised workflow test coverage by ~10% by building 50+ regression tests from real supply chain scenarios, catching 6 prompt and model regressions before release.
Shipped 8+ features end-to-end in a small startup team, from design and code review through deployment and production monitoring, and reviewed 60+ pull requests.

bullets: Ensured secure data storage for 35+ daily active users by engineering a full-stack MERN application with Bcrypt password hashing and JWT authentication.
Enabled the client to manage seasonal menus, track inventory, and process vending requests by building a secure, lightweight platform that eliminated manual coordination overhead.
Drove engagement and shortened order cycles by streamlining menu accuracy and event inquiry workflows, reducing staff workload.
